story.title: How Harry Began His Journey in English Education
story.p1: Beginning during his undergraduate years majoring in English Linguistics, Harry observed that most Vietnamese learners do not lack diligence, but rather a methodology rooted in genuine linguistic context. Studying was often reduced to isolated grammar drills or passive mock testing without real comprehension.
story.p2: Grounded in the conviction that language is a cognitive and connecting tool, Harry started mentoring his first small student cohorts by deconstructing sentence mechanics, standardizing IPA phonetics from scratch, and cultivating direct thought reflexes in English.
story.p3: After 8+ years guiding thousands of learners from foundational basics to 7.5 - 8.5 IELTS, teaching has evolved from a profession into a steadfast mission: empowering students to overcome fear and truly master the language.
